questions.text: Is climate action the core purpose or goal of the policy?
questions.answer: The policy under review, titled 'An Environmental & Climate Change Strategy', clearly indicates that climate action is a core purpose or goal. The policy aims to provide a unified, coordinated, and consistent direction and framework that will guide the progression and understanding of sustainability in Salisbury. It emphasizes that sustainability and responding to climate change should not be a standalone policy, but an overriding strategy that impacts all actions and responsibilities of the Council. This includes maintaining roads, collecting and recycling waste, urban development, transport, and even the behavior of individual employees. The policy also acknowledges the widely accepted fact that the global climate is changing and that past assumptions about the climate can no longer be relied upon. Therefore, it is clear that climate action is a central purpose of the policy.

quote.content: Sustainability and responding to the issues of climate change should not be a stand alone policy, but rather an overriding strategy that impacts on all actions and responsibilities of Council.
